description: Publish a Home page describing Zuno Edu and enrolment entry points.
rationale: Visitors need an accurate starting point.
acceptance: Home displays approved business introduction and course discovery CTA
Draft content is absent from public responses

description: Publish About Zuno Edu information.
rationale: Parents need to understand the provider.
acceptance: About displays only the current published content version

description: Browse published programs and courses.
rationale: Families need course discovery.
acceptance: Course index lists published courses and program grouping
Unpublished course identifiers do not reveal draft details

description: View complete published course detail.
rationale: Families need to assess course fit.
acceptance: Detail includes age group, curriculum outcomes, duration, delivery method and AUD fee
Course reusable curriculum is separate from scheduled cohort details

description: View published upcoming cohorts and timetables.
rationale: Families need to select a suitable delivery.
acceptance: Published cohort detail shows timezone, future session times, availability and enrolment window
No learner roster or private meeting credential is exposed

description: View approved public instructor biographies.
rationale: Families need confidence in teaching staff.
acceptance: Only teacher-approved public biography, display name and approved photo are visible
Teacher contact and operational profile fields never appear

description: Publish how-classes-work guidance.
rationale: Families need technical and learning expectations.
acceptance: Published guidance covers live attendance, preparation, resources and support entry points

description: Publish parent information and FAQs.
rationale: Parents need consistent service guidance.
acceptance: Published parent information and ordered FAQ entries are readable and searchable by page text

description: Provide a contact/support entry point.
rationale: Visitors need a reachable business channel.
acceptance: Contact page offers approved business contact information and validated enquiry form
Submission acknowledges receipt without disclosing other enquiries

description: Publish versioned privacy, terms, policy and child-safety information.
rationale: Families need clear service conditions.
acceptance: Each current published policy has title, version and effective date
Draft legal text cannot be published until the recorded human approval gate is satisfied

description: Offer parent registration and sign-in entry points.
rationale: Acquisition must lead into family enrolment.
acceptance: Every enrolment CTA retains selected course/cohort through successful parent authentication

description: Expose only expressly published public information.
rationale: Public access must not leak private data.
acceptance: Public responses exclude family, learner, billing, meeting-secret and operational data
Direct-object requests cannot bypass publication state

description: Create and verify a parent account.
rationale: The primary account holder must be identifiable and contactable.
acceptance: Registration requires adult account holder name, email and password plus current required acknowledgements
Account email is verified before checkout or child account activation

description: Manage own profile and contact information.
rationale: Service communications need accurate contact information.
acceptance: Parent can edit own name and optional phone
Email change requires confirmation of new address and invalidates affected verification until confirmed

description: Manage optional communication preferences.
rationale: Parents need control of optional communications.
acceptance: Parent can update per-channel optional announcement preferences
Security, billing and material service messages remain mandatory and are labelled as such

description: Record versioned policy and child-service acknowledgements.
rationale: The service needs attributable acknowledgements.
acceptance: Stored record identifies adult, family/student scope, policy version and timestamp
Changed required terms prompt a new acknowledgement before the affected action

description: Register one or more children with minimum required information.
rationale: Families can enrol siblings without excessive data collection.
acceptance: Each child has required first/display name and integer age with age_as_of date
School, last name and preferred name remain nullable
Guardian reconfirms numeric age at each new enrolment if age_as_of is older than 180 days; no exact birth date is inferred

description: Access only children for whom the parent is an active authorized guardian.
rationale: Shared guardianship must preserve family boundaries.
acceptance: Revoked or missing guardian-student relationship returns no child data
A parent may be linked to several children without gaining access to unrelated siblings

description: Browse courses and choose an available cohort for a child.
rationale: Parents purchase an appropriate scheduled course.
acceptance: Course selection identifies child, course, cohort, fee and schedule
Age eligibility and available capacity are evaluated server-side

description: View each child's enrolment status and history.
rationale: Parents need a reliable service record.
acceptance: Own authorized children display pending payment, active, cancelled and completed enrolments with dates and reason where relevant

description: View family schedules and class information.
rationale: Parents coordinate attendance.
acceptance: Calendar/list views include authorized children's sessions, teacher display name, timezone and status
Parent has no mutation granting general scheduling authority

description: View each authorized child's attendance.
rationale: Parents need attendance visibility.
acceptance: Attendance history shows session, recorded status and parent-visible correction state
Other children and private attendance notes are excluded

description: View child's course progress and completion.
rationale: Parents need educational progress visibility.
acceptance: Progress includes required learning items completed and completion status for own authorized child

description: Read released teacher feedback.
rationale: Parents need actionable educational feedback.
acceptance: Only released feedback for an authorized child's learning work is returned
Draft teacher notes remain inaccessible

description: View child's assignments, submissions and released results.
rationale: Parents need to support learning.
acceptance: Assignment due dates, submission status and released assessments are shown
Parent cannot submit work as the child

description: Access child's completion certificates.
rationale: Families need evidence of completion.
acceptance: An authorized parent can download valid child certificate
Revoked certificates are visibly revoked and cannot masquerade as current

description: View relevant events and announcements.
rationale: Families need contextual service notices.
acceptance: Parent sees public, family-role and authorized-child-cohort events/announcements only

description: Read relevant notifications and unread state.
rationale: Parents need a dependable inbox.
acceptance: Inbox shows recipient-specific notifications
Read action changes only the authenticated parent's record

description: View own family's billing and payment history.
rationale: The purchaser needs accurate financial history.
acceptance: Family financial membership is checked independently of child guardianship
Payments, status, amounts and dates belonging to other families are denied

description: Retrieve own family's invoices and receipts.
rationale: Parents need purchase documents.
acceptance: A parent with active billing-family membership can retrieve issued invoice/receipt
Documents contain provider reference and immutable purchase amounts

description: Pay an outstanding eligible enrolment through hosted checkout.
rationale: Parents need an authorized payment action.
acceptance: Checkout uses server-resolved child, family, cohort and price
Repeated create request reuses its idempotent result and does not duplicate a reservation

description: Recover from cancelled or failed checkout.
rationale: Payment failure must be actionable without false enrolment.
acceptance: Parent sees pending/failed/expired status and can retry while eligible
Browser return never alone activates enrolment

description: Manage logout, password and account closure requests.
rationale: Parents need account security and lifecycle control.
acceptance: Logout revokes current session
Password recovery and closure request use authenticated or verified flows without orphaning child guardianship

description: Use a guardian-provisioned student sign-in account.
rationale: Children need safe independent learning access.
acceptance: Guardian initiates credentials for an authorized child
Student identifier is non-public and child email/phone is not required

description: View an age-appropriate learning dashboard.
rationale: Students need a focused next learning action.
acceptance: Dashboard shows own enrolled courses, next class, due work and released announcements
No billing or family-management data is loaded

description: Navigate own enrolled courses by module and lesson.
rationale: Students need a consistent learning journey.
acceptance: Active/completed entitlement exposes only released modules and lessons for own enrolments
Unreleased content is denied via direct URL/API

description: Read supported lesson blocks and learning resources.
rationale: Courses need varied instructional media.
acceptance: Heading, rich text, image, video, download, activity, quiz reference and assignment reference render accessibly
Disallowed embedded content is rejected before publication

description: Download authorized learning resources.
rationale: Students need reusable learning materials.
acceptance: Resource access checks enrolment/release state before issuing short-lived link
Guessing another course asset identifier is denied

description: Complete non-graded lesson activities.
rationale: Students need low-pressure practice and reflection.
acceptance: Student can mark an eligible activity done and update own reflection response
Other students' activity state is not returned

description: Attempt eligible course quizzes.
rationale: Students need formative checks.
acceptance: Student can begin, save and submit own eligible attempt within configured attempt limit
Unsubmitted answers and answer keys are not exposed to peers

description: View assignments and project-work requirements.
rationale: Students need clear deliverables.
acceptance: Assignment detail shows instructions, resources, rubric, due time and allowed submission formats

description: Submit own assignment and project files.
rationale: Students need a safe work hand-in flow.
acceptance: Submission references validated owned file assets and eligible assignment
Successful submit creates immutable version and visible status

description: Track submission history and resubmit when allowed.
rationale: Students need clear retry and correction rules.
acceptance: Student sees draft, submitted, returned and assessed state plus version history
Resubmission is accepted only while assignment policy or explicit teacher return permits

description: View released assessments and quiz results.
rationale: Students need trustworthy learning results.
acceptance: Only own released results are visible
Scores and rubric comments match the released assessment revision

description: View released teacher feedback.
rationale: Students need guidance for reflection.
acceptance: Own feedback includes release timestamp and related work/session
Draft feedback is denied

description: View upcoming classes and details.
rationale: Students need to find the correct live lesson.
acceptance: Schedule contains own enrolled cohort sessions and status in user timezone
Other cohort private detail is excluded

description: Join an eligible assigned live class.
rationale: Students need secure entry to scheduled learning.
acceptance: Active enrolled student receives just-in-time authorized join link within the join window
Teacher start credential is never returned

description: View own attendance.
rationale: Students need a personal learning record.
acceptance: Own session attendance is visible without peer roster or private teacher notes

description: Track own course progress.
rationale: Students need learning continuity.
acceptance: Lesson/activity/quiz/assignment completion feeds a consistent progress view
Refresh does not reset recorded progress

description: View completion status and own certificates.
rationale: Students need recognition on completion.
acceptance: Certificate becomes available only after course completion policy passes
Launch achievement is course completion only

description: Read relevant released announcements.
rationale: Students need useful course notices.
acceptance: Only student-role/cohort audience announcements are displayed
Business or teacher-only notices remain inaccessible

description: Manage safe own profile presentation and logout.
rationale: Students need limited personal control.
acceptance: Student can update optional preferred display name within validation limits and logout
Student cannot alter age, guardianship, roles or billing profile

description: Authenticate as an invited teacher with MFA.
rationale: Teachers access sensitive child educational data.
acceptance: Only activated invited teacher account can enter portal
MFA is required before accessing educational records

description: View assigned teaching responsibilities.
rationale: Teachers need focused delivery information.
acceptance: Dashboard includes assigned courses, cohorts, future sessions and work awaiting review
Unassigned cohorts do not appear

description: Access lesson plans and teaching resources for assigned delivery.
rationale: Teachers need prepared teaching material.
acceptance: Assigned teacher can access published curriculum and cohort teaching resources
Internal teacher material never appears in student projection

description: Initiate assigned live classes.
rationale: Teachers need authorized host access.
acceptance: A current assigned teacher can request short-lived host action in permitted start window
Unassigned teacher and student requests are denied

description: Reschedule a permitted future assigned session.
rationale: Teachers need bounded operational flexibility.
acceptance: Teacher may move assigned not-started session with at least 24 hours notice before original and new start, preserving duration
Overlap with teacher, cohort or enrolled learner sessions, course delivery bounds and cancelled sessions is rejected

description: View assigned class and schedule details.
rationale: Teachers need correct delivery context.
acceptance: Teacher sees assigned session roster and educational logistics
Provider secrets are disclosed only through separately authorized start action

description: Record attendance for assigned sessions.
rationale: Attendance needs accountable recording.
acceptance: Assigned teacher records present, absent, late or excused for active roster students
Actor and recording time are auditable

description: Amend attendance with a reason.
rationale: Mistakes require traceable correction.
acceptance: Assigned teacher can amend before session ends plus seven days and must provide reason
Later correction requires authorized administrator

description: View assigned learners' necessary educational profiles.
rationale: Teachers need relevant context without excessive child data.
acceptance: Projection includes display name, age-as-of, optional educational information and enrolment
Guardian financial/contact details and sensitive internal account data are excluded

description: View assigned course assignments and learner work queue.
rationale: Teachers need efficient review.
acceptance: Queue scopes by active teaching assignment and course
Unassigned learner submissions are denied even when identifiers are known

description: Assess and mark assigned learners' submissions.
rationale: Instruction needs consistent assessment.
acceptance: Teacher records rubric/scoring and outcome in draft assessment
Marking cannot cross assigned cohort boundaries

description: Return assigned work for revision.
rationale: Students need a controlled improvement cycle.
acceptance: Return action includes learner-facing explanation and opens a new eligible submission version
Previously submitted versions remain immutable

description: Create, revise and release feedback for assigned learners.
rationale: Feedback requires deliberate release.
acceptance: Draft is visible only to authorized educators
Release publishes to own learner and guardian audience with notification event

description: Review assigned learners' learning progress.
rationale: Teachers need to identify support needs.
acceptance: Progress view includes assigned cohort learners and required-item state
No global cross-teacher analytics are exposed

description: Read relevant operational notifications.
rationale: Teachers need schedule and delivery updates.
acceptance: Recipient/cohort scoped inbox includes changes and provider issues relevant to assignments

description: Exclude all teacher financial administration access.
rationale: Educational role must have zero finance authority.
acceptance: Payment, refund, invoice, receipt, payment-method, financial-report and price mutation endpoints deny Teacher
Teacher routes and feature modules do not include financial administration components

description: Authenticate as an invited administrator with MFA.
rationale: Privileged control needs strong identity.
acceptance: Admin invitation and activation are auditable
MFA is mandatory for every privileged session

description: View authorized operational dashboard.
rationale: Administrators need business control.
acceptance: Dashboard projects only the admin's granted capability groups
Finance summary requires finance permission

description: Manage parent accounts and account lifecycle.
rationale: Operations need account support.
acceptance: Authorized admin can search, suspend, reactivate and process verified closure with audit reason
Suspension revokes sessions and blocks new protected actions

description: Manage student profiles and verified guardian links.
rationale: Operations need accurate and safe child records.
acceptance: Admin can correct minimum profile and approve/revoke verified guardian association
Link changes preserve history and require reason

description: Manage teacher operational and public profiles.
rationale: Operations need controlled staffing.
acceptance: Admin invites, suspends and edits teaching profile separately from approved published biography

description: Manage narrowly defined role and admin capability grants.
rationale: Privilege changes need explicit control.
acceptance: Only identity_admin may grant/revoke roles and admin capability groups
Teacher/student privilege escalation through profile edit is rejected and grants are audited
Granting an admin finance capability to a Teacher principal is rejected, including indirect role combinations

description: Manage programs and reusable courses.
rationale: The business needs a curriculum catalogue.
acceptance: Admin can create, revise, archive and explicitly publish programs/courses
Referenced courses cannot be destructively deleted

description: Manage modules, lessons, lesson blocks and release rules.
rationale: The business needs structured published learning.
acceptance: Admin orders and validates supported block types
Publication pins coherent curriculum version and cohort release schedule

description: Manage learning and internal teaching resources.
rationale: Educators need safe content assets.
acceptance: Resource metadata defines purpose, audience and course linkage
Only validated ready assets can be published

description: Manage quiz definitions and questions.
rationale: Courses need planned formative assessments.
acceptance: Admin configures supported choice questions, answer key, passing score and attempt limits
Attempted versions remain immutable

description: Manage assignments and project-work definitions.
rationale: Courses need controlled deliverables.
acceptance: Admin defines instructions, due rule, accepted formats, rubric and resubmission policy
Published assignment version remains consistent with existing submissions

description: Oversee assessments and released results.
rationale: Operations need to resolve educational issues.
acceptance: education_admin can inspect and correct assessment through new audited revision
Original grade and release history remain preserved

description: Manage cohort lifecycle and delivery capacity.
rationale: Courses need independently scheduled delivery.
acceptance: Admin creates draft cohort linked to reusable course version then publishes/enrols, closes and completes it
Capacity cannot be reduced below confirmed active seats

description: Create, revise and cancel class sessions.
rationale: Operations need schedule authority.
acceptance: Authorized admin creates non-overlapping timezone-aware sessions, expands recurrence and reschedules with reason
Late change/cancellation triggers participant notices and provider reconciliation

description: Assign and revoke teachers for cohorts/sessions.
rationale: Teaching access requires authoritative assignment.
acceptance: Assignment dates and scopes are explicit
Revocation immediately removes protected access and checks remaining session staffing

description: Manage enrolments and cancellation decisions.
rationale: Operations need to resolve delivery changes.
acceptance: Admin can review, cancel or approve authorized enrolment exception with audited reason
Cancellation and financial refund remain separate explicit decisions

description: Oversee and correct attendance.
rationale: Operations need auditable attendance support.
acceptance: education_admin can inspect scoped roster and correct a record with reason even after teacher correction window

description: Oversee progress and course completion decisions.
rationale: The business needs accountable completion.
acceptance: education_admin can inspect progress and apply evidenced completion override with reason
Override does not erase source learning records

description: Oversee teacher feedback release and correction.
rationale: Operations need safeguarding and quality control.
acceptance: education_admin can review drafts and release/retract inappropriate feedback with audit reason

description: Issue, revoke and reissue completion certificates.
rationale: The business needs controlled completion evidence.
acceptance: Admin reissue/revoke actions preserve prior certificate identifier and reason
Issue requires policy-qualified completion or evidenced override

description: Manage events and audience-scoped announcements.
rationale: The business needs targeted communication.
acceptance: Admin can create, publish, expire and cancel scoped events/announcements
Audience expansion is validated against admin privileges

description: Inspect and retry operational notification delivery.
rationale: Operations need to diagnose missed messages.
acceptance: Admin sees redacted delivery status, attempt count and permitted retry
Retry deduplicates recipient/message intent

description: Manage authorized resources and internal assets.
rationale: Operations need asset lifecycle control.
acceptance: Admin can inspect metadata, quarantine or request deletion with reason
Download still checks asset audience and access purpose

description: Configure approved course/cohort fees.
rationale: Commercial offers need controlled AUD prices.
acceptance: finance_admin can set integer-cent prices and valid effective windows
Existing checkout/order snapshots retain original agreed amount

description: Inspect payment records and reconciliation status.
rationale: The business needs payment operations.
acceptance: finance_admin searches by internal order and provider identifiers and sees authoritative status
Teacher/student and non-finance admin requests are denied

description: Administer full and partial refunds.
rationale: Operations need controlled post-payment remedies.
acceptance: finance_admin requests amount up to unrefunded captured balance with reason
Provider result and retries are idempotent and auditable

description: View and export launch financial reports.
rationale: Operations need reconciled business records.
acceptance: finance_admin filters gross payments, refunds and net amounts by date/status with AUD totals
Export is scoped, audited and excludes card data

description: Manage operational and integration settings.
rationale: Operations need controlled configuration.
acceptance: operations_admin changes validated nonsecret settings and references externally managed secrets
Secret values are never returned in API or audit response

description: Read authorized audit and operational history.
rationale: Privileged actions need review.
acceptance: audit_admin can filter actor, action, target and time
Audit content is append-only and excludes credentials and unnecessary child content

description: Reuse one course across many cohorts.
rationale: Curriculum must not be duplicated for each delivery.
acceptance: Course has independently versioned reusable curriculum
Multiple cohorts reference the same version with separate session and roster data

description: Maintain Program → Course → Module → Lesson → LessonBlock hierarchy.
rationale: Learning needs a coherent structure.
acceptance: Each child has one owning parent within course version and unique position
Cross-course block references are rejected unless explicitly reusable resource links

description: Support the eight launch lesson-block variants.
rationale: Structured content must meet launch teaching needs.
acceptance: Heading, RichText, Image, Video, DownloadableResource, Activity, QuizRef and AssignmentRef have validated type-specific payloads
Quiz/assignment references resolve within the course version

description: Version and release curriculum predictably.
rationale: Student work must remain tied to stable learning definitions.
acceptance: A published referenced version is immutable
Admin release schedule controls when enrolled learners can access each module/lesson

description: Support uploaded media and approved external video resources.
rationale: Lessons need video without unrestricted embedding.
acceptance: Video sources are owned assets or approved allowlisted provider URLs with captions/transcript support
No live-class recordings are captured or published at launch

description: Record activity and lesson completion per enrolment.
rationale: Learning progress needs a reliable source record.
acceptance: Completion writes are idempotent for enrolment/item
Only eligible released learning items can be completed

description: Calculate progress from required course items.
rationale: Completion must have documented meaning.
acceptance: Numerator includes completed required lessons/activities, passed required quizzes and satisfactory required assignments
Denominator is pinned to enrolment course version and excludes optional items

description: Evaluate course completion against explicit policy.
rationale: Certificate eligibility must be deterministic.
acceptance: All required items completed and attendance of at least 80% of delivered non-cancelled sessions makes student eligible
Authorized override requires recorded evidence and reason

description: Generate completion certificates with immutable identifiers.
rationale: Completion evidence must be verifiable and controlled.
acceptance: Certificate contains student's permitted display name, course/version, completion date and unique serial
One active issuance per enrolment/version with audited reissue/revoke

description: Represent course-completion achievement only.
rationale: Recognition must have a bounded launch design.
acceptance: Completion achievement is derived from completion/certificate state
No points, badges economy or public leaderboard is created

description: Maintain explicit cohort lifecycle.
rationale: Delivery needs states independent from curriculum.
acceptance: Transitions draft → published/open → closed/in_progress → completed or cancelled validate schedule and price prerequisites
Cancelled cohort cannot accept enrolments

description: Store authoritative timezone-aware class sessions.
rationale: Families need accurate times through daylight-saving changes.
acceptance: Each session stores UTC start/end plus IANA source timezone
Ambiguous/nonexistent local times require explicit resolution before save

description: Prevent teaching and cohort scheduling conflicts.
rationale: Sessions must be deliverable.
acceptance: Overlapping active sessions for the same cohort, assigned teacher or enrolled learner fail transactionally
Reschedule validates original and new policy windows

description: Expand bounded recurring schedule into individual sessions.
rationale: Recurring classes need manageable exceptions.
acceptance: Weekly recurrence with finite count/end produces individually identified sessions
Editing one instance does not silently alter other sessions

description: Scope teaching authorization by active assignment relationship.
rationale: Teaching access must follow assigned duties.
acceptance: Teacher assignment references cohort and optional session exception plus validity period
Expired/revoked assignments do not authorize data access

description: Create Zoom meetings for scheduled sessions through a provider port.
rationale: Each live session needs an external meeting.
acceptance: Eligible confirmed session produces one idempotently linked meeting
Provider-specific payloads remain inside adapter boundary

description: Synchronize meeting update and cancellation lifecycle.
rationale: External live logistics must match domain schedule.
acceptance: Outbox event updates/cancels meeting after domain commit
Failed sync records actionable status and retries without losing authoritative schedule

description: Issue authorized time-bounded live start/join actions.
rationale: Meeting access must respect enrollment and teaching boundaries.
acceptance: Student and authorized guardian-assisted joins are allowed from 15 minutes before scheduled start until end
Teacher starts from 30 minutes before until end
Cancelled sessions and revoked users are denied
Waiting room is enabled, join-before-host disabled and automatic/local/cloud recording disabled in the launch configuration

description: Handle live-provider failure explicitly.
rationale: Class failures need recoverable operations.
acceptance: Unavailable provider returns retryable delivery status and operational alert
Stored secrets are redacted and no unrestricted fallback meeting URL is published

description: Maintain one attendance record per enrolled student/session.
rationale: Attendance must be consistent and auditable.
acceptance: Unique session/student record stores present/absent/late/excused and recording actor
All amendments preserve prior value/reason in audit

description: Notify participants and synchronize external systems after schedule changes.
rationale: Schedule changes must reach affected people.
acceptance: Committed session revision emits deduplicated notification, Zoom and Calendar intents
UI identifies pending provider sync while showing authoritative time

description: Validate child/cohort eligibility before reservation.
rationale: Enrolment must respect guardian authority and course suitability.
acceptance: Active guardian relationship, billing family membership, required consent, age band, enrolment window and capacity are checked server-side
Duplicate active child/cohort enrolment is rejected
Age must have been confirmed in the preceding 180 days and active sessions must not conflict with the child’s existing enrolments

description: Reserve a cohort seat during checkout.
rationale: Concurrent checkout must not oversell delivery.
acceptance: Seat reservation is transactional and expires after 30 minutes
Concurrent successful reservations cannot exceed cohort capacity

description: Activate enrolment only after verified payment.
rationale: Learning entitlement must correspond to authoritative commercial state.
acceptance: Signed provider event/server retrieval matching order amount/currency confirms payment and activates valid reservation once
Late success after expired unavailable seat enters paid_exception requiring admin resolution and does not oversell

description: Track enrolment lifecycle and educational entitlement.
rationale: Commercial and learning state need clear transitions.
acceptance: pending_payment → active → completed or cancelled with expired/paid_exception alternatives is documented
Failed checkout does not grant content/live access

description: Cancel enrolment with accountable reason.
rationale: Business cancellations need clear records.
acceptance: Admin cancellation immediately revokes future class joins and new submissions
Completed historical records remain viewable to authorized family for configured retention

description: Make payment and cancellation conditions explicit before checkout.
rationale: Parents need informed purchase acceptance.
acceptance: Order summary identifies child, cohort schedule, fee, terms version and refund/cancellation policy
Required acknowledgements are recorded against order

description: Resolve paid enrolment exceptions without losing financial records.
rationale: Late/duplicate payment needs safe handling.
acceptance: Admin may allocate an available seat or refund recorded payment with reason
No silent activation beyond capacity and no payment deletion occur

description: Define immutable quiz questions and marking rules.
rationale: Attempts need reproducible scoring.
acceptance: Launch questions are single-choice and multiple-choice with exact-match scoring, no negative marks
Published answer key is server-only until permitted result release

description: Manage quiz attempts within configured limits.
rationale: Attempts need reliable save and submission.
acceptance: Quiz allows configured 1–5 attempts with default 3
Submit is idempotent, server scored and freezes answers
Required quiz completion uses best score meeting default 70% or configured threshold

description: Release formative quiz results after submission.
rationale: Learners need timely feedback.
acceptance: Submitted attempt returns own score, correctness and approved explanation
Answer key from other unsubmitted quizzes is never included

description: Specify assignment rubric, deadline and revision policy.
rationale: Work must be assessed against known requirements.
acceptance: Assignment pins rubric/version and due instant per cohort
Late submissions are accepted and labelled late by default until cohort completion unless explicitly closed

description: Preserve immutable submission versions.
rationale: Teacher review needs trustworthy submitted work.
acceptance: Only student-owned ready files from the expected upload purpose may be submitted
Each version records submitted_at and superseded version with no overwrite

description: Record draft assessment against a specific submission version.
rationale: Assessment needs stable provenance.
acceptance: Assessment references immutable submission and rubric version, score/outcome, assessor and timestamp
Concurrent updates require version precondition

description: Release and revise assessment deliberately.
rationale: Learners must see approved results.
acceptance: Draft result remains educator-only
Release exposes result and feedback to learner/guardian
Correction creates a new revision and triggers targeted notice

description: Maintain private-draft and released educational feedback states.
rationale: Feedback visibility must be intentional.
acceptance: Draft → released → retracted transitions retain authorship and revision history
Retraction removes family/student view while audit remains

description: Use one-time AUD cohort fees at launch.
rationale: Billing must be simple and definite.
acceptance: Every payable cohort resolves one integer-cent AUD fee with display total
No subscription, instalment, marketplace, coupon or discount path exists

description: Create server-priced Stripe Checkout payment sessions.
rationale: Hosted payment reduces card-data handling.
acceptance: Server resolves immutable order amount, currency, child and cohort
Client price or family identifiers cannot change authorized purchase
Card details are entered only on Stripe-hosted UI

description: Maintain immutable order and payment references.
rationale: Transactions need reconciliation and financial auditability.
acceptance: Order/payment retain internal UUID, checkout session, payment intent, charge/provider IDs where supplied, amount/currency and status history
Provider identifiers are unique where required

description: Verify Stripe webhook authenticity before processing.
rationale: Payment events are security-sensitive.
acceptance: Raw request signature and freshness are validated
Invalid or replayed event cannot change financial/enrolment state

description: Process payment events idempotently and out of order safely.
rationale: Providers retry and may reorder notifications.
acceptance: Unique provider event is persisted and processed once
State transitions use verified current provider state and duplicate delivery has no duplicate effect

description: Represent checkout, payment and refund status separately.
rationale: Financial truth must not be collapsed into a browser state.
acceptance: Created/pending/succeeded/failed/cancelled payment and refund pending/succeeded/failed states map to provider truth
Browser redirect is informational only

description: Issue immutable purchase invoice/receipt representations.
rationale: Parents and the business need transaction documents.
acceptance: Verified payment issues a downloadable receipt with provider reference and order snapshot
Invoice representation follows approved merchant tax/invoice settings and is versioned rather than overwritten

description: Perform idempotent full or partial refunds within captured balance.
rationale: Business remedies require financial controls.
acceptance: Requested total never exceeds captured amount minus succeeded/pending refunds
Refund success is verified from provider and linked to original payment with reason/actor

description: Reconcile provider transactions to local financial records.
rationale: Failures must be discoverable and recoverable.
acceptance: Scheduled reconciliation compares pending/exception payments and refunds to provider identifiers
Mismatch creates actionable exception and cannot silently rewrite immutable amounts

description: Produce launch payment/refund/net financial reports and exports.
rationale: Operations need useful financial reporting.
acceptance: Date-bounded report totals integer AUD cents and identifies timezone/status basis
CSV formula injection is neutralized and export is audited

description: Separate financial refund from enrolment entitlement decision.
rationale: Partial refund must not silently cancel education.
acceptance: Refund request includes explicit KEEP or CANCEL educational-entitlement disposition authorized to finance admin
Cancellation reasons and financial outcome remain separately auditable

description: Apply approved merchant identity, tax and refund policy settings.
rationale: Production purchases need human-approved business configuration.
acceptance: Production checkout is blocked until merchant, tax/invoice wording and refund terms gates are approved
Architecture uses versioned immutable order snapshots regardless of selected legal/tax settings

description: Send account registration and security emails through a provider port.
rationale: Accounts need reliable verification and recovery.
acceptance: Registration, verification, reset and email-change messages use purpose-bound expiring tokens
Sensitive tokens do not enter logs

description: Send enrolment confirmation after authoritative activation.
rationale: Families need accurate enrolment notice.
acceptance: One confirmation is queued per activated enrolment and includes child display name, course/cohort and schedule link

description: Send verified payment/receipt and refund outcome notifications.
rationale: Families need financial confirmation.
acceptance: Only verified successful financial transition queues success message to authorized billing recipients
Notification links require authenticated document access

description: Send class reminders and schedule-change notices.
rationale: Participants need timely logistics.
acceptance: Reminder intent is scheduled for 24h and 1h before session, adjusted for newly created sessions
Reschedule cancels old reminder intents and queues revised notices

description: Send assignment and released-feedback/result notifications.
rationale: Learning actions need targeted follow-up.
acceptance: New due-work and release events target permitted learner/guardian inboxes
Email goes to adult verified contacts and avoids detailed child assessment content

description: Send completion/certificate communication.
rationale: Completion should reach the learner's family.
acceptance: Completion creates learner inbox notification and adult email with authenticated certificate link exactly once per issuance event

description: Provide recipient-scoped in-app notifications.
rationale: All roles need a consistent operational inbox.
acceptance: Notification record has audience, kind, safe summary, action link and read timestamp
One recipient cannot read/update another recipient's notification

description: Publish role/course/cohort-scoped announcements and events.
rationale: The business needs safe targeted notices.
acceptance: Audience and publication/expiry time are explicit
Private audiences never appear in public listing or feed

description: Deliver noncritical email in background with retry and deduplication.
rationale: Provider latency must not block ordinary API work.
acceptance: Domain commit writes durable outbox intent
Worker uses bounded backoff, dead-letter status and redacted delivery log
Repeated intent never knowingly sends duplicate logical message

description: Create Google Calendar events from authoritative sessions/events.
rationale: External calendar needs accurate mirrors.
acceptance: Calendar adapter upserts one provider event per domain session/event revision and stores external ID
No provider-side edit automatically overwrites domain schedule

description: Synchronize schedule updates and cancellations.
rationale: Mirrors must not show obsolete classes.
acceptance: Reschedule updates same linked event
Cancellation marks/deletes provider event and persists sync revision/status

description: Represent recurrence as individually linked session events.
rationale: Session exceptions must remain manageable.
acceptance: Each expanded recurrence occurrence has its own domain and external ID
One exception updates only that session event

description: Offer authorized add-to-calendar exports.
rationale: Families need convenient personal calendar use.
acceptance: Authenticated user can export per-session ICS for owned/assigned schedule
Export contains no peer data or teacher host secret and uses stable UID/revision

description: Recover calendar synchronization failures.
rationale: External failure must not corrupt the timetable.
acceptance: Retry is idempotent and dead-letter/operational status is visible
Domain session remains authoritative and usable while sync is pending

description: Store authoritative file metadata and object references.
rationale: Object storage needs governed ownership.
acceptance: File record contains owner, purpose, audience, expected MIME/size, checksum, storage key and lifecycle state
Database IDs are used in business contracts instead of raw keys

description: Validate uploaded files before availability.
rationale: Uploads must not become a security bypass.
acceptance: Student submission allowlist is PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT and approved project ZIP, maximum 25 MiB (26,214,400 bytes) per file and 100 MiB (104,857,600 bytes) per submission; executable/script content is rejected and archives are scanned with expansion limits

Learning resources permit PDF, PNG, JPEG and TXT up to 50 MiB, MP4 up to 500 MiB or approved HTTPS video references; internal assets permit PDF, PNG, JPEG and TXT up to 25 MiB; generated certificate PDFs are limited to 5 MiB
Pending/unscanned files cannot be downloaded or submitted

description: Use short-lived presigned uploads and authorized downloads.
rationale: Browsers need secure object transfers.
acceptance: Upload grant expires within 10 minutes and is bound to object/purpose/size
Download grant expires within 5 minutes after current resource authorization
Permanent credentials are never exposed

description: Quarantine unsafe uploads and make scan status explicit.
rationale: Unsafe media must not reach children.
acceptance: Scanner failure leaves file pending/quarantined and produces operational alert
Only ready state assets can be referenced in published content/submissions

description: Enforce file access through ownership and related-resource scope.
rationale: Storage possession must not bypass authorization.
acceptance: Student own submission, guardian authorized child, assigned educator and explicit admin permission determine access
An arbitrary storage key or asset ID cannot grant access

description: Delete eligible files and clean orphaned uploads safely.
rationale: Storage must observe lifecycle and minimization.
acceptance: Unfinalized objects older than 24h are removed after reference check
Deletion tombstones metadata and asynchronously removes object after retention/legal hold checks

description: Protect object storage and generated documents.
rationale: Private teaching and child files need confidentiality.
acceptance: Buckets are private with encryption and scoped service credentials
Certificates/internal documents use same authorization and lifecycle controls as other assets

description: Authenticate accounts with secure password/session flows.
rationale: Every protected surface needs trusted identity.
acceptance: Passwords use Argon2id
Login issues opaque server-side session via HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie
Invalid login returns generic error without account enumeration

description: Require MFA for educator and administrator roles.
rationale: High-impact child/admin access needs stronger authentication.
acceptance: TOTP with single-use hashed recovery codes is mandatory for privileged role activation
Enrollment/recovery is audited and recovery cannot bypass verified support process

description: Rotate and revoke sessions safely.
rationale: Stolen or stale sessions must be controllable.
acceptance: Login privilege change and password reset rotate/revoke sessions
Idle expiry 30 minutes for staff, 12 hours parent/student with absolute lifetime seven days
Logout clears current session

description: Recover adult accounts through expiring single-use tokens.
rationale: Users need safe recovery.
acceptance: Reset token expires after 30 minutes and is stored hashed
Successful reset consumes token and revokes sessions
Responses do not reveal email existence

description: Reset student credentials through authorized guardian/support action.
rationale: Children need recovery without required personal email.
acceptance: Verified active guardian or identity_admin resets authorized child's credential with audit
Student cannot obtain guardian session or email token

description: Authorize using role, relationship, ownership and resource state.
rationale: Role labels alone cannot protect data.
acceptance: Every protected application operation evaluates actor capabilities plus resource relationship/state
Denied direct-ID and modified-client requests have no side effect

description: Enforce guardian/student and billing-family authorization separately.
rationale: Shared guardianship must not expose unrelated family finances.
acceptance: Child educational read requires active GuardianStudent link
Billing requires active FamilyGuardian billing membership
Guardian link alone never grants another family's payment records

description: Restrict students to own permitted educational data.
rationale: Student portal must remain a private learning environment.
acceptance: Cross-student submission/profile/progress/certificate IDs are denied
Billing, administration, peer/private staff and family-management APIs deny Student

description: Restrict teachers to current educational assignments and deny finance.
rationale: Teacher scope must not expand through guessed IDs.
acceptance: Expired/unassigned cohort/student reads fail in service and query layer
All finance repositories and API operations reject teacher capability context

description: Use explicit administrative capability groups.
rationale: Administrative access needs least privilege.
acceptance: identity_admin, education_admin, finance_admin, operations_admin and audit_admin gates apply per operation
No self-grant without identity_admin and audited privilege policy
Teacher principals cannot hold admin financial capabilities or gain finance through additive roles; a separate MFA-protected admin principal is required

description: Suspend and close accounts without losing required records.
rationale: Account lifecycle needs safe access removal.
acceptance: Suspension revokes sessions and disables new login immediately
Closure follows authorized erasure/retention review and does not delete immutable financial/audit records

description: Test all role and resource boundaries negatively.
rationale: Hidden navigation is insufficient protection.
acceptance: Tests cover Teacher→payment/unassigned learner, Parent→other child/family, Student→other submission/billing and nonprivileged Admin→finance
API, service and scoped repository tests prove denial

description: Minimize child registration data.
rationale: Children should not surrender unnecessary information.
acceptance: Name and numeric age are required, school optional, no DOB required
Health, address, biometric and identity-document fields are absent from default child schema

description: Record purpose, visibility and retention for each personal-data field.
rationale: Data collection needs accountable limits.
acceptance: DATA_REQUIREMENTS names each collected field, purpose, permitted role projection and retention class
Unknown fields fail validation rather than silently storing arbitrary sensitive data

description: Preserve versioned policy acknowledgements and approval gates.
rationale: Appropriate service consent needs evidence.
acceptance: Acknowledgement links policy version, scope, actor and time
Legal text and child-safety publication are blocked pending recorded human review

description: Protect production secrets outside source and responses.
rationale: Provider and infrastructure credentials must remain secret.
acceptance: Secret references are injected at runtime from protected environment/store
Scanning rejects committed credentials and logs/API redact secret values

description: Validate inputs and defend web/API boundaries.
rationale: Untrusted requests must not corrupt data or sessions.
acceptance: Typed schemas reject unknown/invalid fields
CSRF protects cookie-auth mutations
CORS uses explicit origins
Rich text is sanitized and query construction is parameterized

description: Apply abuse limits to authentication, contact, checkout and uploads.
rationale: Public and financial entry points need abuse resistance.
acceptance: Account/IP limits enforce 5 login attempts per minute per identity plus broader IP control, 3 reset requests/hour, 5 contact/hour, 10 checkout/hour/family and configurable upload quota
Limits return retry guidance without leaking account existence

description: Audit privileged and sensitive transitions append-only.
rationale: Security and financial events need accountability.
acceptance: Role/guardian changes, student access exports, schedule overrides, result corrections, refunds, settings and certificate changes record actor, action, target, timestamp, reason and correlation ID
Secrets and full child work content are excluded

description: Keep logs and diagnostics free of unnecessary child/financial content.
rationale: Observability must not create a second sensitive database.
acceptance: Logs use internal opaque IDs and redacted error summaries
No passwords, tokens, payment credentials, submission bodies or raw provider webhooks appear

description: Support verified personal-data access/correction/deletion requests.
rationale: Operations need a privacy request workflow.
acceptance: Admin records request, verifies adult authority, exports permitted data and applies correction/retention decision
A request cannot expose another guardian's unrelated finances

description: Enforce retention, archival and legal-hold states.
rationale: Records need deliberate lifecycle management.
acceptance: Approved retention matrix drives scheduled purge/anonymization with evidence
Held records are not purged and hold changes are audited

description: Publish child-safety reporting route and restrict child communication.
rationale: The teaching service needs clear safeguarding boundaries.
acceptance: Parent/student can locate approved reporting channel
No student-peer messaging or teacher-private-chat system is built
Live rooms use waiting-room controls and recording is off

description: Verify webhooks and provider callbacks at trust boundaries.
rationale: External callbacks must not become privilege bypasses.
acceptance: Provider signature/authenticity and event deduplication occur before domain mutation
Unsupported/invalid event types are safely rejected or ignored with redacted audit

description: Secure upload scanning, encrypted transport and private storage.
rationale: Child work must not be publicly exposed.
acceptance: HTTPS is mandatory
Objects/backups are encrypted at rest
Unsafe file state blocks all audiences and presigned grants expire

description: Prevent destructive or untraceable financial/admin mutation.
rationale: High-impact records need controlled changes.
acceptance: Money uses integer minor units, optimistic version checks protect concurrent edits and append-only histories preserve financial truth
Audit deletion is unavailable through ordinary admin UI

description: Provide reproducible containerized deployment for OCI-compatible VPS.
rationale: The business needs operable production hosting.
acceptance: Documented Docker/Compose stack includes Next.js, FastAPI, worker, PostgreSQL, Redis and Caddy with health/dependency checks
Domain code contains no OCI dependency

description: Terminate HTTPS with Caddy and expose only intended services.
rationale: Production needs encrypted network boundaries.
acceptance: Only HTTPS/required HTTP redirect and controlled administration ingress are externally reachable
Database/Redis internal ports are not public

description: Validate environment and integration configuration at startup.
rationale: Misconfiguration must fail visibly.
acceptance: Missing/invalid required configuration prevents readiness and identifies safe setting names
Secrets are not printed

description: Manage PostgreSQL schema through reviewed migrations.
rationale: Data changes need repeatable rollout.
acceptance: Every migration has upgrade validation, backup/rollback or forward-fix plan and compatibility review
Production does not auto-migrate on every web replica start

description: Run Redis-backed workers with durable PostgreSQL outbox.
rationale: Async delivery must survive process failures.
acceptance: Jobs are idempotent, retry bounded and dead-lettered
Outbox prevents lost intent after successful database commit and Redis loss can be recovered from durable state

description: Run CI quality, contract, security and test gates on PRs.
rationale: Merged work must meet the locked design.
acceptance: CI validates lint/type/build/tests, requirement/chunk coverage, contract consistency and secret/dependency scans
Failure blocks review-ready handoff

description: Use separate development, staging and production environments.
rationale: Release validation must not expose live children.
acceptance: Environments isolate credentials, databases, buckets and providers
Synthetic staging data is used and production data is not casually copied

description: Provide liveness/readiness and dependency health visibility.
rationale: Operations need to distinguish failure modes.
acceptance: Liveness avoids sensitive data
Readiness checks essential dependencies with bounded timeout
Provider degradation is reported without making whole service unnecessarily unavailable

description: Collect structured logs, metrics, errors and actionable alerts.
rationale: Incidents need evidence and timely response.
acceptance: Correlation IDs link API/job/provider attempts
Alerts cover error rate, payment mismatch, stale jobs, provider sync and backup failure without child-content leakage

description: Back up PostgreSQL and object storage with retention and encryption.
rationale: Production data must survive infrastructure loss.
acceptance: Database PITR/WAL target RPO ≤15 minutes plus daily base backup
Object storage versioning/daily inventory and encrypted backup policy are documented

description: Demonstrate complete restore into an isolated environment.
rationale: A backup is useful only if restoration works.
acceptance: Restore exercise validates DB integrity, object references and protected access within RTO ≤4 hours
Evidence records date, duration, exceptions and remediation

description: Document incident, rollback and provider-failure recovery.
rationale: Operations need executable runbooks.
acceptance: Runbooks cover deploy rollback, DB migration failure, credential rotation, queue recovery, provider outages and privacy incident escalation with owner contacts

description: Scan dependencies, containers and secrets.
rationale: Production needs a maintained security baseline.
acceptance: CI and scheduled operations produce actionable dependency/container vulnerability reports
Unresolved Critical/High exploitable findings block launch

description: Deploy with versioned artifacts and verified smoke checks.
rationale: Releases need controlled rollout.
acceptance: Deployment records commit/image/config/migration versions and validates health plus critical journeys
Rollback uses previously known image and schema-compatible procedure

description: Pass a formal production launch gate.
rationale: Merged feature PRs alone do not prove launch readiness.
acceptance: All required requirements are implemented and traced, Critical/High findings resolved, integrations/security/restore/accessibility/end-to-end checks evidenced and human business/legal gates approved

description: Meet a measurable interactive performance baseline.
rationale: Users need responsive service on ordinary connections.
acceptance: At 100 concurrent authenticated users, read API p95 ≤500ms and write p95 ≤1s excluding file transfer/provider checkout
Normal authenticated navigation p75 LCP ≤2.5s on defined mobile test profile

description: Target reliable monthly service and visible degradation.
rationale: Scheduled teaching needs dependable access.
acceptance: Production target is 99.5% monthly availability excluding approved maintenance
Health/alerting and incident records permit calculation and failed integrations expose retryable status

description: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA for launch critical journeys.
rationale: Every surface should be usable with assistive technology.
acceptance: Keyboard, focus, labels, contrast, error announcements and screen-reader checks pass critical flows
Video content includes captions/transcript and diagrams have text alternatives

description: Support current desktop and mobile web viewports.
rationale: Families need access across common devices.
acceptance: Critical flows work at 360px mobile and 1280px desktop with current Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge plus previous major browser versions
No essential action depends on hover alone

description: Use one OOP modular backend with dependency inversion.
rationale: All portals need one authoritative business model.
acceptance: Domain entities/value objects/policies contain invariants without framework/provider imports
Application services orchestrate repositories/ports
API endpoints contain no scattered business rules

description: Maintain one versioned API contract and generated frontend types.
rationale: Surfaces must not drift from backend meaning.
acceptance: Every UI operation maps to documented /api/v1 contract/service and permission policy
Contract validation detects missing routes, incompatible schemas and duplicated handwritten frontend DTO definitions

description: Preserve transactional consistency and concurrency safety.
rationale: Seats, money and learning revisions need reliable state.
acceptance: Unit-of-work boundaries, unique constraints, version preconditions and outbox protect concurrent mutations
Conflict returns actionable 409 and never silently overwrites newer data

description: Prove critical behavior at domain, API, persistence, adapter and UI layers.
rationale: Feature presence is insufficient without verification.
acceptance: Negative authorization, migration, provider retry/idempotency and critical end-to-end journeys have required automated coverage
Accessibility and restore tests have recorded evidence

description: Follow the locked blueprint and purposeful reuse.
rationale: Future chunks need predictable architecture.
acceptance: Durable classes/services/ports/components map to blueprint and requirements
Material deviations stop affected chunk for review
Private helpers need no architecture redesign

description: Keep requirement, design, chunk and verification traceability complete.
rationale: Launch scope must resist creep and erosion.
acceptance: Every required ID maps to object/service/API or justified operational consumer, chunk and tests
Every chunk serves approved requirements and dependency graph is acyclic

description: Execute one deterministic chunk from synchronized remote master.
rationale: Fresh sessions need safe repeatable continuation.
acceptance: Agent fetches/fast-forwards master without modification, reconciles merged evidence read-only, selects eligible chunk deterministically, branches once, reviews/tests and hands off PR_OPEN
Only human remote merge enables COMPLETE

description: Use least-data projections across all five surfaces.
rationale: Shared backend must not mean shared visibility.
acceptance: DTOs explicitly whitelist permitted fields for public, family, student, assigned teacher and admin capabilities
Cross-surface tests prove financial and child-data segregation
